warnings: This sheet establishes the roof-eave dummy grid lines (1', 3', E'', A') in the grid master, all at 1.00m beyond the main building grid on every side, backed by a real steel eave/hip beam (ตะเข็บลันเหล็ก) per the beam-endpoint rule -- not merely an architectural overhang annotation.

A detail callout 'ดูขยาย 1' (see detail 1, at 1:20) on the same sheet shows the purlin-to-hip-beam bolted/welded connection using a 'เหล็กหางปลา' (fish-tail steel bracket, 50x300x6.00mm) embedded in the pedestal concrete -- recorded as a connection_detail would be appropriate but is left out of elements[] here since it has no grid position of its own; flagged for a future pass to add as a connection_detail element if needed.

Ridge point position (grid 2 x row C) is a read from the drawn crossing location relative to the main grid circles, not from an explicit printed dimension to the ridge -- lower confidence than the rest of the grid master, which is dimension-sourced throughout.
